subject: RE: FW: ZURICH AIRPORT - MEL / 87 PLT 3,459 KGS
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! Our buyer in Beijing is importing some electronic control units from us in Germany, and I’m arranging the flight for their import. Could you quote the cheapest air freight option to PEK (Beijing, CN)?

The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27 at our site in 42401 (Wuppertal), Germany. It’s 8 pieces, with a gross weight of 1081 kg and a volume of 8.03 cbm.

Could you arrange the truck from our site to the airport and include it in the all-in price in EUR for this import shipment?

Thanks for taking a look!

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG


-----Original Message-----
Sent: 2026-10-03
Subject: ZURICH AIRPORT - MEL / 87 PLT 3,459 KGS

Dear team,

pls quote air freight ex ZURICH AIRPORT to MEL:
